key_insight: AI-required CPT codes remained rare but had 9.88 times higher odds of appearing in encounters in 2025 than in 2021, with uneven use across patient groups.
clinical_relevance: Billed AI-enabled services were more common among older and Medicare-insured patients and less common among Medicaid enrollees and residents of socially vulnerable areas.
method: Serial cross-sectional analysis of Epic Cosmos encounters from January 2021 to April 2026.
Identified 65 AI-required CPT codes by matching CPT codes to FDA-listed AI-enabled devices.
Compared use across patient, geographic, and payer characteristics.
evidence_signal: Among 11.6 billion encounters involving 233.6 million US patients, 335,349 encounters included an AI-required code—2.9 per 100,000 encounters.
watch_item: CPT-coded encounters do not capture all clinical AI use, and unadjusted group differences do not establish causes of unequal use.
paper_title: Use of AI-Related CPT Codes by Patient, Geographic, and Payer Characteristics in the U.S., 2021-2026
